instruction: Candid studio photograph, full-shot at eye-level. In a bright dance studio with a large mirror, the woman in a black leotard and white tights (R1) stands on the right foreground with her back to the camera, holding the hands of the young girl in a pink tutu (R2) overhead. The girl (R2) stands en pointe facing the mirror with her back to the camera. The woman (R1) supports her balance. Their reflections are visible in the mirror on the left. Soft, bright daylight illuminates the clean studio space.
